description: Kiro V3 headless/ACP and the forked hermes-kiro-provider on V3 ACP, Hermes v0.22.2 behind the gatekeeper, the live chat model switch, and the live V3 checks with the 'ossbot-hermes' key (phase2-plan.md items 11-15; PLAN.md items 27-28). Answers the user's question 'can we directly use kiro v3 cli and update hermes-kiro-provider if needed': the fork keeps the V2 code untouched and adds a V3 adapter selected by HERMES_KIRO_ACP_ENGINE=v3 (default). Depends on FEAT-005 (relay, surface check) and FEAT-006 (common/models.py, catalog, real model ids).
steps: Item 11: research first, record before coding. Re-fetch https://desktop-release.q.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/latest/manifest.json (2026-10-18: still 2.32.0). If a 3.x CLI is out: bump kiro_cli in config/versions.lock.yaml (version, url, sha256 from the manifest), update the ADR-0011 addendum, and let the images step rebuild sandbox-llm (probe tuple changes, so FEAT-006's probes must pass again: rerun ossctl doctor --probes). If not: stay on 2.32.0 with --v3 / --agent-engine=v3 and record that. Read the V3 ACP migration guide https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/v3/acp-migration/ (the page is client-rendered; if web_fetch returns only the footer, use web search results, the docs repo/raw markdown, or 'kiro-cli acp --help' from the pinned binary) plus the ACP and auth pages; verify DESIGN §23 items 10, 11, 12, 5c (V3 ACP auth with an API key: env KIRO_API_KEY vs --auth-method=client + _kiro/auth/getAccessToken; currentModeId and advertised tool-list field names; set_config_option ids 'model'/'effortLevel'; promptCapabilities.image/audio for FEAT-009). Record everything in a new 'Implementation addendum (FEAT-007)' in docs/adr/0002-agent-runtime-hermes-kiro-acp.md.

Item 12: vendor the provider. Download tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider at 02c4dd06585436751145961658a22b773f23a0ef as the commit archive (https://codeload.github.com/tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider/tar.gz/02c4dd06585436751145961658a22b773f23a0ef) into the gitignored d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\.ossbot-local\vendor-src\ (never a submodule, never a remote of this repo), copy into vendor/hermes-kiro-provider/ as plain files keeping LICENSE (MIT), add UPSTREAM_COMMIT and UPSTREAM_URL, and commit it UNMODIFIED alone ('chore(vendor): import hermes-kiro-provider@02c4dd0 unmodified'). Then add: kiro_acp/v3_core.py (stdlib only: launch_spec() -> ['/home/hermes/.local/bin/kiro-cli','acp','--agent-engine=v3'(+ '--auth-method=client' if item 11 says so)], cwd /home/hermes/.hermes/kiro-cwd, env HTTPS_PROXY=http://10.212.0.2:3141; session_new_params() with _meta.kiro {modeId:'ossbot-chat', modelId, effortLevel} from models.yaml roles.chat via the resolved id; assert_surface(session) with expected_mode/allowed_tools; permission answering reject_once > reject_always > cancelled, never synthesized options, never _meta.kiro.consent; NDJSON JSON-RPC framing with Section 20 size limits; -32601 for unknown agent->client requests; a redacting JSON-RPC logger that never logs the result of _kiro/auth/getAccessToken), kiro_acp/v3.py (Hermes provider glue on the upstream external_process seam: handlers registered before session/new, capability gating on agentCapabilities/_meta.kiro.extensionMethods, model/effort switch via session/set_config_option before each session/prompt when the resolved chat model changed (mtime-cached models.yaml), never session/set_model, turn completes on the session/prompt response, transport drop -> re-register + session/load without resending, on_surface_violation hook), kiro_acp/hermes_plugin.py (registration; the plugin manifest names it; kiro_acp/__init__.py stays import-free, R5-N3), engine selection HERMES_KIRO_ACP_ENGINE=v3|v2 (v3 default; V2 code path untouched). The upstream shim extends Hermes's in-tree copilot-acp client and its file-safety bridge: the V3 adapter must not expose any file bridge capability to the agent (record how in the ADR addendum). Declare vendor/hermes-kiro-provider as a non-editable uv path dependency in pyproject.toml, uv lock, sync DEV and ROOTDEV venvs. Tests: tests/fakes/fake_acp_v3.py (scripted NDJSON JSON-RPC stdio server) and tests/acp/{test_v3_contract.py,test_mode_mismatch.py,test_hermes_probe_eval.py,test_model_switch.py} covering AC 20 (capability gating, _meta.kiro on session/new, set_config_option never set_model, reject options or cancelled, unknown request -> JSON-RPC error, access token absent from every log record, argv has --agent-engine=v3 and none of --agent/--model/--effort/--trust-*, mode vibe or an advertised read tool -> no session/prompt and kill requested, model change between turns -> exactly one set_config_option).

Item 13: Hermes install and wiring. Replace the Decision 8 no-ops in scripts/lib/{kiro.sh,hermes.sh} and scripts/provision.sh: step 'kiro-cli for hermes' (manifest + sha256 tarball into /home/hermes/.local/bin, the shared sandbox/kiro/settings/cli.json and a hermes permissions.yaml denying shell/read/write/glob/grep and ~/.kiro/**, /proc/**, /sys/**, /dev/**, /run/**, /etc/**) and step 'hermes' (DESIGN §15.4 script verbatim in intent + R5-N2: flock /run/ossbot/hermes-upgrade.lock for the whole step, stop ossbot-hermes-probe.socket first, repeat the pgrep -u hermes refusal after the rollback pkill); record the peeled commit (git rev-parse v0.22.2^{commit}) as hermes.peeled_commit in config/versions.lock.yaml; read the tag's setup-hermes.sh and reproduce only its non-dependency steps (list them in the ADR-0002 addendum, §23 item 13). Add hermes/config/{config.yaml.j2,permissions.yaml} (allowlisted toolsets of §15.1 rendered from a tier parameter defaulting to 'locked' - FEAT-009 adds the other tiers; tool_search off and verify how v0.22.2 parses it; approvals/cron/unattended keys verified at v0.22.2), hermes/plugins/ossbot/{plugin.yaml,__init__.py,tools.py} (ossbot_status, ossbot_queue, ossbot_contribution, ossbot_logs, ossbot_request_discovery, ossbot_notify, ossbot_pause, ossbot_kill over the gatekeeper UDS; never imports ossbot.gatekeeper), .kiro/agents/ossbot-chat.json (tools web_search, web_fetch only), systemd/ossbot-hermes.service (User=hermes, API server on 127.0.0.1:8642, egress only via 3141, the full non-root hardening pattern with ProtectHome=tmpfs + BindPaths=/home/hermes so /run/user stays hidden, P1-17), systemd/ossbot-hermes-probe.socket (/run/ossbot/hermes-probe.sock, SocketGroup=gatekeeper, 0660, Accept=yes, MaxConnections=1) + ossbot-hermes-probe@.service (root oneshot, ConditionPathExists=!killed); all added to OSSBOT_ENABLE_UNITS, the kill stop list and tests/system/lib.sh. src/ossbot/ctl/hermes_probe.py (root ACP client + evaluator per §15.2: python -I, imports kiro_acp only from /opt/ossbot/app/vendor/hermes-kiro-provider, adapter_sha256 drift check with O_NOFOLLOW, runuser -u hermes for kiro-cli, deterministic pass rule over the NDJSON, result to /var/lib/ossbot/probes/hermes-kiro.json root:gatekeeper 0640, non-blocking upgrade lock -> inconclusive 'Hermes is upgrading', --selftest, --handshake-only per PLAN Decision 11). ossctl 'hermes upgrade|login|probe' and 'kiro upgrade'. Doctor: replace the three Hermes SKIP checks (commit vs lock, hermes-side Kiro probe, kiro settings (hermes)) and add 'chat relay' state. tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh: add hermes:127.0.0.1:8642 to the host-listener allowlist and probe the new units. Tests: tests/unit/ctl/test_hermes_probe_paths.py (code origin under the root copy, PYTHONPATH ignored under -I, drift -> adapter_drift), tests/system/test_hermes_install_hygiene.sh (incl. the mid-upgrade probe-trigger case), tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py extended.

Item 14: redeploy twice (bootstrap -Only provision; second run only 'unchanged'), confirm versions as hermes, run the real handshake ROOT /opt/ossbot/app/.venv/bin/python -I -m ossbot.ctl.hermes_probe --handshake-only and append the redacted outcome to the ADR-0002 addendum, run the hermetic bar and the system tests.

Item 15: LIVE checks with the 'ossbot-hermes' key through product code only (results in docs/VERIFICATION.md '## Phase 2 live checks'): (a) Kiro headless --v3 round-trip with the Hermes key: extend 'ossctl kiro smoke --key hermes' (root runs runuser -u hermes -- kiro-cli chat --v3 --no-interactive --agent ossbot-chat --output-format stream-json with the env loaded by root code from hermes.env, canned JSON prompt, nothing secret printed); (b) 'ossctl hermes probe' passes with the real key (relay gate opens; if auth option (a) fails, try (b) per §15.2 and record which works; (c) device flow needs the user and is only reported); (c) a REAL V3 ACP session through the forked provider: add gatekeeper endpoint POST /v1/chat/selftest (operator role) that relays one fixed prompt through ChatBackend -> Hermes -> kiro-acp v3 and returns redacted metadata (engine, mode, model, latency, answer length); run it via 'ossctl chat selftest' and also deliver the 🤖 answer to the configured user's Telegram chat; (d) live chat model switch: 'ossctl model set chat <another catalog id>' then selftest again shows one session/set_config_option and the new model (Hermes not restarted); set it back and commit config/models.yaml only if it changed; (e) doctor shows the relay enabled. If a check fails because of the key (API keys not enabled for ACP, org policy), record it under 'User action needed' in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md and leave the relay disabled; do not work around it. Set status completed, write findings (Hermes state layout for backups: memory/session files and paths; auth option that works; mode/tool fields; set_config_option ids; image/audio prompt capabilities), commit locally.
acceptance_criteria: DEV pytest -m "unit or acp" passes AC 20 plus test_model_switch.py; vendor/hermes-kiro-provider keeps LICENSE, UPSTREAM_COMMIT, UPSTREAM_URL and the unmodified import is its own commit
test_hermes_probe_paths.py and tests/system/test_hermes_install_hygiene.sh (incl. the mid-upgrade case) pass; test_egress_surface.sh passes with the Hermes units loaded
After bootstrap: kiro-cli --version as hermes prints the pinned version, hermes --version prints v0.22.2, a re-run prints only 'unchanged', ossbot-hermes is active
The real kiro-cli acp --agent-engine=v3 handshake ran and its redacted outcome is in the ADR-0002 addendum together with the §23 items 10-13 and 5c findings

Live: Hermes-key headless round-trip, hermes-side probe, a real V3 ACP session through the forked provider via the gatekeeper selftest, and a live chat model switch without restart are recorded in docs/VERIFICATION.md (or the key problem is recorded under 'User action needed' in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md)
